EvolutionRateParams.description: Rates the usages of one turn. Without `targetKey` the rating applies to every usage in that turn. A usage is addressed by its recorded turn id (`turnId`, as `evolution/ratings/list` reports it) or by its recorded tool call (`toolCallIds`, the turn's `skill` calls the client shows). The latest rating of a usage stands: an opposite rating or a new reason is appended as a new observation (earlier ones are kept, not counted); repeating the standing rating appends nothing. With `subagentId` the client still addresses the parent thread it owns; the server resolves the child agent thread through the parent's agent registry and `turnId` refers to the child turn. An unknown or unowned subagent fails with `evolution_target_not_found`.
EvolutionRateParams.title: EvolutionRateParams

EvolutionRateResult.description: `recorded` is whether the requested rating now stands for at least one usage of the turn; `false` when no usage of the turn is recorded (for example the skill call failed, its target is off, or the data was cleared) or the rating control signal is off.
EvolutionRateResult.title: EvolutionRateResult
